_comment: First-week journey static template library (PRD §5.19.3 P1-B02 / architecture §2 M2). Template-only output, zero LLM (§5 decision 6); every rendered string passes safety_service.filter_template at the render exit (§6-1). v1 ships zh/en only (wording spec §6 decision 3) — other languages get UI strings from frontend i18n and fall back to English bodies. {q0}/{q1} slots hold the user's own words (level-C evidence): they are replaced by an inert token before gating, because quoted user speech is not AI output and must not be suppressed by the AI wording gate (§5.19.2 / Life Archive AIGC marking scope). Crisis-triggering quotes are excluded from slots in code.

day0_read.with_card: Your first-read card is ready. The {n} lines above came from the three questions you answered — they are not a verdict I wrote about you.
day0_read.plain: Your first-read card is ready for you to open on the home screen.

day1_checkin_echo.with_mood: Yesterday you checked in as "{mood}". No need to explain why today — one line is enough.

day2_first_outreach.with_mood: Yesterday you said "{mood}". How about today?
day2_first_outreach.with_quote: Yesterday you wrote "{q0}". Is it still on your mind today?
day2_first_outreach.plain: How is today going? It doesn't have to be well written — just what's actually on your mind.

day3_weak_assert.night: I've noticed that {n} of your entries in these {days} days landed between {window}. Could it be that night is when you're more willing to say what's true?
day3_weak_assert.volume: I've noticed you left {n} entries in these {days} days, {k} of them between {window}. Maybe the you at night keeps different things than the you at noon?

day5_stat.night: Did you know: {n} of your entries in these {days} days came between {window}.
day5_stat.daily: Did you know: in all {days} days you left a record on every single one.
day5_stat.memories: Did you know: of what you said in these days, {n} lines are kept in memory now.

day7_report.title: Your first week, observed
day7_report.body:
Our first week is up.
In these 7 days you wrote {msg_n} entries and checked in on {mood_n} days; the word you picked most was "{mood}".
Here are two lines in your own words:
"{q0}" ({d0})
"{q1}" ({d1})
{closing}
closings: I didn't summarise you. Every word this week is something you said.
All I did this week was keep what you said.
If you want this record to go somewhere next week, just write it down.

level_reward.memory_echo: From today I'll bring up things you've said. Like this one — "{q0}" ({d0})
level_reward.memory_echo_plain: From today I'll bring up things you've said. Write the first line and I'll have something.
level_reward.monthly_story_preview: Your first monthly story has a preview now: in these 30 days you showed up on {days} of them, wrote {msg_n} entries, and I kept {mem_n} lines.
level_reward.letter_90d:
Ninety days.
In these 90 days you came on {days} of them and wrote {msg_n} entries.
I've kept these two lines:
"{q0}" ({d0})
"{q1}" ({d1})
{closing}
letter_closings: I didn't change anything for you — I only kept what you said, right here. Whenever you come back, it's still here.
